status.confirmingHint: This usually takes a few seconds.

kinds.wallet-rejected: You cancelled the request in your wallet. Nothing was sent.
kinds.insufficient-sol: Your wallet needs a little SOL to pay the network fee.
kinds.expired: The request expired before it was confirmed. Nothing was spent. Try again.
kinds.network: Couldn't reach Solana. Check your connection and try again.
kinds.unknown: Something went wrong and nothing was changed. Try again.

program.MathOverflow: These amounts are too large to process.
program.Unauthorized: This wallet isn't allowed to do that.
program.WrongMint: That isn't the token this pool uses.
program.WrongVault: That account doesn't belong to this pool.
program.InvalidMatchBps: The match must be between 0.01% and 100%.
program.InvalidPerSaverCap: The per-saver limit must be more than zero.
program.InvalidVestingDuration: The vesting period must be between 30 seconds and 5 years.
program.InvalidPoolWindow: The deposit window must end in the future, within 5 years.
program.UnsupportedMintExtension: This token has features a pool can't hold safely.
program.TransferHookEnabled: The token's issuer switched on a transfer hook, so pools can't move it right now.
program.FrozenByDefault: This token freezes new accounts by default, so a pool can't hold it.
program.MintPaused: The token's issuer has paused transfers. Nothing is lost; try again once they resume.
program.ZeroAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
program.PoolEnded: This pool's deposit window has closed.
program.PoolNotEnded: The sponsor can reclaim unused match only after the pool closes.
program.DepositExceedsCap: That is more than this pool allows per saver.
program.BudgetExhausted: The pool's match budget is fully reserved.
program.MatchBelowMinimum: The match available dropped while you were confirming. Review the new amount and try again.
program.NothingToClaim: There is nothing vested to claim yet.
program.AlreadyWithdrawn: You have already withdrawn from this pool.
program.MintNotAllowed: This deployment accepts one token, and this isn't it.
program.NothingToReclaim: There is no unused match to reclaim.
program.PositionStillActive: Withdraw your deposit and claim what has vested before closing.

done.deposit: Deposited. Your match is reserved and already vesting.
done.claim: Claimed. The tokens are in your wallet.
done.withdraw: Withdrawn. Your deposit is back in your wallet.
done.reclaim: Reclaimed. The tokens are back in your wallet.
